bundle.shortDescription: A user-visible FairyOS presence shell for Windows.
bundle.longDescription: Faeryware gives RavenOS and FairyOS a resident Windows surface with tray presence, summon links, native notifications, local-only event ingress, colony continuity, six deterministic Digi Fae states, and an embedded model carrier.
